title: The draft-pr guard lets a Write whose text names a PR create
why: The draft-pr guard (record draft-until-reviewed) refused a Write of a test fixture whose text held the PR-create command words (coordinator, 16:50 CST Nov 7). A guard that cries wolf is spent.
note: Same guard as step draft-pr-guard-heredoc (the heredoc false alarm). Done check: a red test on the Write, then green, with a real create still refused. Sighting (triage 13:59 CST Nov 8): draft-pr refused a Bash call whose python heredoc only wrote step text naming the PR-create command; no PR was created. The same text run from a script file passed.
